topic: The Magic of Transformers: How Machines Understand Context

sections.title: Introduction: The Prediction Game
lecture_lines: Lex needs to complete this squirrel's story.
It evaluates several possible words to fill the blank.
Lex calculates that 'acorn' has the highest probability.
The most likely word completes the sequence perfectly.
LLMs are powerful statistical engines for predicting text.
animations: Create a robot icon 'Lex' (#00FFFF) and text 'The squirrel climbed the tree to hide its ___' (#FFFFFF).
Display three completion options: 'acorn' (#00FF00), 'bicycle' (#FF0000), 'cloud' (#FF0000) below the sentence.
Scale 'acorn' up while 'bicycle' and 'cloud' fade out, showing '98% probability' label.
Move 'acorn' into the blank spot to complete the sentence text.
Display label 'LLMs are statistical prediction engines' (#FFFF00) at the top.

sections.title: Prerequisite: Words as Coordinates (Embeddings)
lecture_lines: Computers process words as unique points in space.
Similar meanings cluster together in this high-dimensional map.
Vector math reveals the deep relationships between concepts.
animations: Display words 'King' (#3399FF), 'Queen' (#FF66CC), 'Apple' (#00FF00), 'Fruit' (#CCFFCC) at random positions.
Transition words into semantic clusters: (King, Queen) and (Apple, Fruit).
Show vector math text 'King - Man + Woman = Queen' (#FFFF00) with connecting arrows.

sections.title: The Problem: The 'Bank' Dilemma
lecture_lines: Old models process words sequentially and forget context.
This creates confusion for words with multiple meanings.
Does 'bank' mean a river edge or money storage?
animations: Display two sentences: 'I went to the bank...' and 'I sat on the river bank...'.
Draw connecting arrows from 'money' to 'bank' (sentence 1) and 'river' to 'bank' (sentence 2).
Change 'bank' colors to #00FF00 (money) and #3399FF (river) to show meaning shift.

sections.title: The Core Mechanism: Self-Attention
lecture_lines: Transformers analyze every word in a sentence simultaneously.
Self-attention determines which words relate to each other.
It resolves ambiguity by focusing on relevant context.
'It' connects strongly to 'animal' using attention weights.
This uses the math of Query and Key vectors.
animations: Write 'The animal didn't cross the street because it was too tired.'
Highlight the word 'it' (#FFFF00) and make it pulse.
Draw connecting lines from 'it' to every other word in the sentence.
Thicken the line to 'animal' (#00FF00) and thin the line to 'street' (#FF0000).
Display 'Attention Weights' as a heat-map bar (#FFFFFF) below the sentence.

sections.title: The Transformer Architecture: Parallel Power
lecture_lines: Older models worked like a slow conveyor belt.
Transformers work like a high-speed panoramic camera.
This parallel processing allows training on the entire internet.
High-speed training enables models to become incredibly massive.
Parallelism is the secret to modern AI performance.
animations: Draw a conveyor belt labeled 'Old Models' (#808080) moving words one by one.
Animate a camera flash icon (#FFFFFF) over the whole sentence 'The cat sat...'
Show the sentence entering a stack of 5 orange layers (#FF9900) simultaneously.
Draw parallel vertical arrows flowing through all layers at once.
Display text 'Parallelism enables massive scale and speed' (#00FFFF).

sections.title: Emergence: From Math to Intelligence
lecture_lines: Massive scale leads to surprising emergent properties.
Models transition from word-fillers to versatile AI assistants.
Complex reasoning emerges from simple mathematical foundations.
animations: Show a small yellow spark (#FFFF00) labeled 'Simple Word-Filler'.
Expand the spark into a massive sun-like sphere (#FFA500) labeled 'AI Assistant'.
Animate labels 'Code', 'Poetry', and 'Logic' (#FFFFFF) emerging from the sphere.
